closest_prior_work.relation: Selected the final-label cached value through L8H3 and L8H7 within numbered lists, but did not interchange factors across behaviors.
Established exact weight equivalence and causal necessity in lists and sequences, but failed repeated-list and word-copy selectivity; deletion did not distinguish score routing from cached value.
The complete H3+H7 state passed all numeric target directions but failed active controls, so its finer factor stage stayed closed and no cross-format factor interchange was evaluated.

novelty: First matched cross-behavior causal test of the exact L8H3/H7 semantic-source attention score and cached-value factors. A new paired authority gives numbered-list and digit-sequence prompts the same visible labels and next-label answers, removing the disjoint-label confound. It compares within-format and cross-format transfer of final-source score, cached value, and their joint term, plus earlier-source and two-head interactions.

registered_screens.shared_payload_private_router: cross-format cached-value transfer preserves at least 70 percent of within-format cached-value effect in all behavior-by-direction cells with at least 75 percent donor-direction rows and positive CE support, while score transfer may fail
registered_screens.shared_score_and_payload: cross-format joint transfer preserves at least 70 percent of within-format joint effect and cross-format score transfer preserves at least 50 percent in every behavior-by-direction cell
registered_screens.cooperative_two_head_service: if neither head alone qualifies, the joint H3+H7 term qualifies only when its margin interaction is at least 10 percent of the full effect with the same sign in both behaviors
registered_screens.generic_numeral_or_copy_bus: target transfer holds but any repeated-list-copy, digit-copy, or step-two active control fails
registered_screens.location_only_null: matched target transfer itself fails, leaving only the already-known shared module and head location

required_controls: freeze a paired authority with identical visible labels and next-label answers across list and digit-sequence formats before outcomes
native recipient and donor capability at least 85 percent in every target and control cell
exact replay, source sum, and cached-value decomposition relative squared errors at most 1e-10; installed term error at most 1e-5
within-format joint effect recovers at least 50 percent of the natural margin effect with at least 75 percent donor-direction rows
same-state cross-format transfer is an invariance control and opposite-state transfer is the causal successor intervention
apply identical nonzero factor arms to repeated-list copy, digit-copy, and step-two controls; intervention norm at least 10 percent of target scale
controls preserve at least 75 percent answers or registered preferences, absolute mean CE change at most 0.10 nat, and median absolute margin change at most 25 percent of target scale
full-vocabulary RMS is descriptive only; task margin and CE determine the verdict
FIT chooses only a preordered factor subset and SELECT tests that identical subset without reselection
interpretation_limits: A pass establishes operational reuse on matched list and digit-sequence formats, not an abstract numeral concept.
The exact factors are source score and cached value contributions, not whole attention heads or a rank-reduced proxy.
Fresh numeric values, templates, and word-number transfer remain separate confirmation questions.
